text: I don’t want to be a thief! I’ll just catch wild\nPokémon.

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Please tell me the way! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Where am I supposed to go from here? I haven’t\ngot a clue—I’m just aimlessly wandering...

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Was losing to you supposed to help me find\nmy way?!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If you get lost and don’t know where to go, like\nme...try asking at the Pokémon Center.

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hey, are we\nschoolmates?! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You go to the academy too, right? Let’s pool our\nknowledge and trade tips...after we battle!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: How do you know so much more than me when\nwe’ve been taking the same classes?!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Across the river, you’ll find the South Province’s\nArea Four. It’s got stronger Pokémon than here!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Do you have one? ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You’ve got a Tera Orb, right?! That’s so cool!\nLemme see, lemme see, lemme see!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So sparkly I got distracted!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_TANPAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Some Pokémon change into different types when
they Terastallize, right?\c
I wish I had a Scatterbug that could turn into a
Fire type. That’d be so cool...

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Pokémon quiz tiiime! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What’s two feet, four inches tall and weighs\n45.2 pounds?

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Did you figure out the answer?

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You should have Gible registered in your\nPokédex now, thanks to our battle! Check out its\r\nhabitat and see if you can catch one!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh, happy day! ♪ ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I bought some delicious cake from Patisserie\nSoapberry! Let’s celebrate with a battle!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: This cake makes me so happy, I don’t even\nmind losing!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Katy, who runs Patisserie Soapberry, is the best\npatissier around. And she’s even a Gym Leader!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Welcome! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Can I interest you in our daily battle special?\nOur regulars say it’s electrifying!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That’s it. I’m closing up shop.

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Lots of customers have to go buy a Paralyze Heal\nafter they try my battle special. Hee hee!

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m so curious about\nTeam Star... ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You go to the academy, right? Do you know\nabout Team Star?

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I was so busy thinking about Team Star, I lost...

label: TRID_AREA04_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I hear Team Star builds bases and claims whole\nlittle zones for themselves.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You a new kid? ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey, new kid! I know what’s up around here.\nLemme take a look at your Pokémon for ya!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: OK, that was legit hilarious!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Check out these words of wisdom: Those big\nPokémon Center signs make great landmarks.\r\nMakes you less likely to end up lost!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You know the\nArtazon Gym? ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Have you been to the Artazon Gym? I sure have!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: The tragedy I went through at the Artazon Gym\nhas struck again!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Gym Leader, Brassius, absolutely wiped the\nfloor with me.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Sparkle, sparkle!\nTwinkle, twinkle! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! I gotta tell you about this! It was all\nsparkly...and all twinkly!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now we’re all bruise-y and lose-y.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I saw this sparkly Pokémon and I went up to try\nand catch it...when it suddenly Terastallized!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Dun, dun, dun-da-dun! ♪ ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Dun, dun, dun-da-dun! ♪ That’s the sound of\nhealing up at the Pokémon Center!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Guess I better go ask for another round of\ndun, dun, dun-da-dun...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe I ought to buy some Potions while I’m at\nthe Pokémon Center.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Let’s show each other\nwhat we’ve got! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Here, I’ll show you my Pokémon first!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I got shown more than I bargained for...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Pokémon you see in battle get registered in your\nPokédex app, so I try to battle a lot.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m gonna scare\n’em so bad! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Suddenly, from the bushes... BOO!!! Ha! Bet you\nnever saw that coming!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost?! I didn’t see that coming at all!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe something good’ll happen if I sneak up\non a Pokémon that doesn’t see me coming...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It was incredible! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: There was—! That rock wall—! There was a—!\nThat Pokémon—! Incredible! You know?!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I think losing to you has calmed me down.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I was leaning on this rock wall, and suddenly it\njust started...moving! It scuttled up the cliff!\c\nWas that thing I thought was a wall...a Pokémon?

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Treasure hunting... ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You’re doing the Treasure Hunt, aren’t you? I did\nit too, back in the day.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ah, to be young...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Treasure Hunt’s basically tradition at\nthe academy.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I want a jolt of\ninspiration! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I want to write a song, but it just won’t come to\nme... I need some kind of spark!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now THERE’S a spark!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I bet I can write a fine song with that jolt of\ninspiration you gave me!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Heeey! Guess! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! Guess who my favorite teacher at the\nacademy is?

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Iiit’s...Mr. Jacq!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You’re in Mr. Jacq’s class?! Lucky!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Well, for now... ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: For now...let’s battle!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost...for now!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’ve got no idea what to do on my Treasure Hunt.\nFor now, I just gotta figure out the next step...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Battle me,\nfor I am mighty! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Battle me, for I have given my Pokémon a mighty\nitem to hold...and I am mighty!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My might and my items meant nothing in the face\nof a mighty Trainer like you!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I gave one of my Pokémon some Leftovers to
hold so it’d recover HP bit by bit!\c
You can spot mighty Trainers like me by how we
speak. Our strength colors everything we say.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Makin’ the rounds,\nround and round... ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m out making the rounds! Which means I’m on\nthe job, but I’m out and about!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My surroundings are spinning round and round...

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s kinda nice to get to be outside while I’m\nat work.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I need a model\nfor my new work... ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I think my next work shall be a portrait...of you,\ncollapsed in defeat!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Battle... Art... Both are fiendishly tough pursuits!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I still need to find a model for my next piece.\nPreferably someone I can beat.

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s all about balance! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve got Pokémon of a bunch of different types,\nso we can have a well-balanced battle!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Agh! Now I’m off-balance!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Having different types of Pokémon with you\nshould help you handle different situations!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Treasure Hunt\nis so much fun! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m doing the Treasure Hunt, too. And no fresh-\nfaced kid is gonna beat me!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: If that’s how you battle, I’m sure you’ll be able to\nfind your treasure!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: No matter how old you get, having new life\nexperiences is always a treasure!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Come say hi!\nCome say hiii! ▶

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Yaaay! You came! So, wanna baddle?

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You baddle really good!

label: TRID_AREA08_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When someone says somefin’ that gets your\nattention, you just gotta talk to ’em, right?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My own secret base! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: This right here is my secret base! I’m gonna beat\nyou and then you gotta go!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What?! Wait, does this mean I have to go?!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s tough getting all the way up here to our\nsecret base, huh?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Scrub-a-dub! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you washing your Pokémon nice and clean?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I got washed away!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Area Four of the South Province is a big place—\nplenty of room for a thorough Pokémon washing!\r\nA little of that fresh feeling goes a long way!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Begging your pardon... ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Begging your pardon... Could I trouble you for\na battle?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m begging your par-done for!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess in those old-timey shows, when people\nbeg someone’s pardon, they’re usually asking for\r\nhelp or directions or something, not a battle.

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ve covered up\nmy weakness! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: This Berry is my ace in the hole! It’s covered up\nmy weakness!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Even with one less weakness, I lost...

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: There’re some Berries that Pokémon can hold to\ntake less damage from a supereffective move.\r\nGives you one less thing to worry about!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Treasure ahoy! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I know where there’s treasure! Maaaybe I’ll tell\nyou...if you can beat me!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: The real treasure was definitely not meeting you!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I saw a treasure chest up on top of that tower!\nBut it started moving around on its own, so I, uh,\r\ngot kinda freaked out and didn’t open it...

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Good ol’ Pokédex! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I love filling in my Pokédex! Don’t you?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I don’t love battles quite as much.

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Your Pokédex will tell you where Pokémon’s\nhabitats are and when you might find them!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I wanna see! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I wanna see the cute li’l Pokémon you’ve got\nwith you!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Awww! What [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0607)]a cutiecuties!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: There’re so many kinds of Pokémon! And they’re\nso cute!

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Is this a dead end? ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: It feels like such a waste to hit a dead end and\njust turn back with nothing to show. So...shall we?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I should have just turned back...

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If I just had a way to ride a Pokémon up cliffs,\nI could get to the South Province’s Area Six...

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Excuse me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Let’s get down to it. Please forgive my being\nbarefoot.

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Perhaps I’d have had a chance if I’d been\nwearing boots...

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_KARATE_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I know other Black Belts go around barefoot...\nDo rocks and things just not hurt them?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Are these Pokémon\njust too strong? ▶

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Is it me, or are the Pokémon around here way too\nstrong? We should probably turn back, huh?

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess I’d be fine out here if I were as strong as\nyou are.

label: TRID_AREA05_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Beating stronger Pokémon makes you stronger in\nturn, but that only works if you can actually win...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Two whole decades! ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve got twenty years of studies at the academy\nunder my belt!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Twenty years...for this...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I was so short on credits I had to take a 20th\nyear! Maybe it’s time I graduated...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: If you shorten pants... ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If you shorten pants, do you get a pan?

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now I’ve got short pants, but a long face...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Would you say you’re more of a shorts person or\na pants person?

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: How about it? ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: How about a nice Pokémon battle? I’ve got some\nspare time and I’d like to do something fun!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ahhh, that was fun.

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Some moves look cool, some moves hit hard...but\nmy favorites are the ones that are just plain fun.

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Do you know of Kofu? ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Kofu, the Cascarrafa Gym Leader, is quite strong!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess now you know how strong I am!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Kofu is a user of water Pokémon! Take care lest\nyou be swept away by his strategy!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Great Crater\nof Paldea... ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Why is the Great Crater of Paldea off-limits,\nI wonder?

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Guess if a kid can beat me, I’m better off not\ngoing anywhere dangerous...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I heard the depths of the Great Crater of Paldea\nare defended by a super-powerful guardian!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ve got a guitar... ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve got a guitar that doesn’t make a sound!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m as victorious as my guitar is loud...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Sometimes I carry around my silent guitar to\ntoughen up my arms and neck!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The joy of youth! ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What is youth, though? Do you have an answer?

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Aaah, the folly of youth...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe you only really understand your youth\nwhen you look back on it as an adult.

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: A weird Pokémon! ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: There was a weird Pokémon! There was a weird\nPokémon!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I saw a weird Pokémon, I swear! I’ll tell you more\nin a bit!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I ran into a weird Pokémon out in the desert.\c\nIt looked like Donphan, but I think it actually\nwas a different Pokémon...

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So much sand! ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What d’you think will happen if sand gets into\nmy shoes?

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Maybe I’ll just go bury my head in the sand!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If the sand stays inside my shoes for too long,\nI start to grow fond of it!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Yooo-hooo! ▶

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Yaaa! Huagh?! Hey, how’d you get up here?!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oooh, by riding your Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA10_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Your Pokémon climbed up here, right?\n...Wait, can Cyclizar climb?

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m a worker! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m a worker! If you need work done, I’m\nyour man!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Pokémon battles aren’t work!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Workers like me can build any kind of building,\nwhether it’s a school or the Pokémon League HQ!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Teach me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Teach me! Teach me the feeling of defeat!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So this is what defeat feels like!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Defeat’s really something else. Thanks for\nteaching me!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Don’t worry! I’ve got it! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Yes, I’ll take care of this mess... I’ll clean you out!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’ve cleaned me out!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: No matter how messy battles get, I love to\nsee them!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I forgot to do\nmy homework! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I forgot to do my homework! If I win, you gotta\nlet me copy yours!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait, we’re not even in the same class...

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: So, which classes are you taking? I’m in, like,\nbattle studies and biology and stuff!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hikers are super popular! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I heard that I’d be super popular if I became\na Hiker!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Hiking up the mountain of popularity!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess Hikers are popular with Pokémon. I’m OK\nwith that!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I spy a mountain! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: A mountain of an opponent! Let me reach\nyour summit!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Coming down off the mountain...

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess you were too much of a mountain for me!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I have this really\ncool classmate! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I have a classmate whose [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad is a famous\nprofessor!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: There’s nothing particularly cool about me.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Don’t you think it’d be cool to have a parent\nthat’s famous?

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: She was so strong... ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: A superstrong girl asked me to battle! I lost\nbefore I could even blink!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: And now I lost to you, too!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: That superstrong girl... She had to be Champion\nRank. No doubt about it.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Rarrr! Raaarrrr! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you wanna see my super cool Pokémon\nfigurines?

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Grrryaaa! Craaash! I lost!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Your Pokémon [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0302)]isare super neat! If they ever make\n[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0E0E)]a figure of itfigures of ’em, you bet I’ll collect [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0C01)]ithe whole set!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It doesn’t matter. ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: It doesn’t matter how old you are if your\nPokémon are strong.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re strong! And young!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: With Pokémon, a child can defeat an adult!\nThat’s what makes it so fun!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Where did you\ncome from? ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Oh, you’re from Cabo Poco? I’m from\nMontenevera!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I was representing Montenevera but I still lost...

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The snow in Montenevera is gorgeous! And we\nhave a beautiful concert stage too!\c\nI bet Cabo Poco doesn’t have all that!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Which do you like? ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you like studying in the classroom? Or do you\nlike adventuring in the wild?

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, I can tell you definitely like Pokémon.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Me, I prefer to stay in my classroom and study!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hoo hah! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hoo hah! Hoo hah!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess just shouting wasn’t enough to win.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Hoo hah!\nI tried copying the shouts of a martial artist I\r\nlook up to, but I couldn’t win anyway.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Monsters! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I love Pokémon that are like the monsters\nin movies!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I can’t believe my monster was defeated!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MANIA_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: In the movies, the monsters always lose. But in\nreal life I’d like them to win!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I want to protect\nthis beach. ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey, did I just catch you littering?! I need to\nbattle you to protect the beach!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Sorry about that... Seems like I was mistaken.

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
This is the Secluded Beach, one of the Ten
Sights of Paldea.\c
It’s not so secluded anymore, what with all the
attention it’s gotten as a tourist location...

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I need your help! ▶

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I need a real workout!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now that was a good workout! I was sweating\na ton!

label: TRID_AREA07_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Pokémon battles are great exercise for the\nTrainers, too! It’s just the best!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: ...Let’s battle.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: ...You’re strong.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: That was fun... Bye...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Where’s Alfornada? ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Let’s have a battle. It’ll help me feel less alone\nand lost.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost. This does nothing to help my anxiety.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Supposedly, I can reach Alfornada if I just follow\nthe road, but...is this even a road...?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What a great view! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I wanna get a selfie of me beating you with this\ngorgeous view as a backdrop!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: A selfie of my defeat, huh?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I wanted a selfie so I could use it for my icon\non my profile!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Focus! Gotta focus! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I lost at the Alfornada Gym so I’m doing some\nmore training.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Yet another defeat!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Tulip, the Alfornada Gym Leader, is a skilled
Trainer of Psychic-type Pokémon.\c
My Fighting-type Pokémon didn’t stand
a chance...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Putting my trained\nlegs to use! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text:
One! Two!
One! Two!\c
I trained using the torturously long staircase in
front of the school!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I wish training my legs also made my Pokémon\nstronger.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
That staircase in front of the school sure is
ridiculously long, isn’t it?\c
You can catch the student council president
sitting down for a breather from time to time.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m so worried! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: A child, out all on your own? Why, you have me\nworried sick! I’ve got to get you back to town!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, well, if you’re that strong, I suppose I\nneedn’t worry.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Watch out for dangerous Pokémon and strange\npeople, OK?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: This slope is awesome! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: This is an absolute paradise for us hikers!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It’s like I’m climbing into the sky!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Flat paths are so boring. Just like life, you gotta\nhave peaks and valleys!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Your future is hazy. ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Let me see your future. Let’s see if you’ll make it\nout of this cave!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’ll be fine wherever you go...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Alfornada is ahead, after you climb this cave\never upward.\c\nFollow the torches. They will be your guide.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Where am I? ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I was running after Pokémon and...now I’m\ncompletely lost!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Lost my way to victory too...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_TANPAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If I really get stumped, I’ll call a Flying Taxi.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Whew... Just a\nlittle more... ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I swore to myself that I’d make my way to town\nwithout riding on my Pokémon.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My legs are about to give out, and I’m about to\ngive up...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess it’s a good time for a breather! And I’ve\ngot some sandwiches for my Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: This is so much fun! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Treasure hunting is so much fun! And it’ll be even\nmore fun when I beat you!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Losing isn’t fun!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: This Treasure Hunt project is fun, isn’t it?\c\nIt’s a great chance to really reexamine yourself!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Gotta remember\nPokémon types... ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Pokémon types are so complicated, don’t\nyou think?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Not complicated for you, huh?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: OK, so I get why Water is strong against Fire...\nBut why is Dark strong against Psychic?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So much work! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: *huff* *puff*\nIt’s so much work to get to town from here!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I bet I’d have won if I wasn’t so tired.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I wish they’d give me a bonus for each delivery\nI make to Alfornada.

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Did I see you riding\non a Pokémon? ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I didn’t know there was a Pokémon that could\nclimb these steep slopes with a rider...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I thought I’d trained pretty hard...

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Such a mysterious Pokémon... I’ve never seen\nanything like it!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Behold these muscles! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I built up these muscles by many trips to the gym!\nMy brilliant brawn will surely lead me to victory!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My massive musculature misled me!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The gym I go to isn’t a Pokémon Gym, you know!\nIt’s a human gym!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: How does today’s\nweather look? ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll tell you why I’m so worried about the weather!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Sandstorms are weather too, you know!\n...I swear! They are!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
The truly frightening thing about a sandstorm is
not the damage it deals...\c
it’s the fact that Rock-type Pokémon get a
Sp. Def boost and become even hardier!

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: ’Scuse me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Wouldja be so kind as to battle me? As, like,\ncelebration for reaching Alfornada?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait...this isn’t Alfornada?

label: TRID_AREA06_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You’re saying Alfornada is beyond Alfornada\nCavern...? I need to climb even more?!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Map says it’s around\nhere somewhere... ▶

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You wouldn’t happen to know the address for the\nTeam Star Poison crew’s base, would you?

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I misread the map, and I misread the course of\nthat battle!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It seems like Team Star’s Poison crew set up their\nbase across the river.

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Gotta study hard! ▶

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey, aren’t you a student?! You should be at\nschool!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You schooled me!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You should go back to the academy now and\nthen to attend class. You’ll learn a lot!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What colorful trees... ▶

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you know why these trees have so many\ncolors on them?

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Waaaaaah! Now I’m all bluuueee!

label: TRID_AREA13_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The colorful markings on these trees were\npainted by a Pokémon called Grafaiai.\r\nThat Pokémon is a real artist. Just like me!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Heeey, you wanna\nbuy this? ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Oh ho ho! You bought it—my fake out, that is!\nNow it’s battle time!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That little joke really cost me!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Did you know that shops will buy your items? But
you’ll only get a quarter what you’d pay for ’em.\c
If you want to make money, sell items like
Nuggets—that’s really all they’re good for!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Ahhh, Steel-type Pokémon! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll show you how strong and sturdy Steel-type\nPokémon can be!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Did you already know how to get around\nSteel-type Pokémon’s sturdy strength?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Steel types don’t have all that many weaknesses,
and they can’t be poisoned!\c
They get KAPOW’ed by Fighting-type moves,
though...plus Fire-type moves melt them down!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: This is Area Three of\nthe East Province! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Area Three of the East Province is a mining belt!\nWe dig, dig, dig for metals!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I see you’re no stranger to hard work!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe this is a good time for me to head back\nto Zapapico and rest up!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So, about those mines... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you think people can go hiking in mines?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess you wouldn’t know, huh?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: No matter the reason, kids like you should stay\noutta mines! You’re a minor, not a miner!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My Pokémon!\nIt evooolved! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Want to help my newly evolved Pokémon with\nsome target practice?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My Pokémon’s so newly evolved, it doesn’t\nknow how to battle!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s amazing how Magikarp evolves into Gyarados.\nI wish I could evolve into a Pokémon, too...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Ptooey! Blech... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: There’s so much sand around here, my mouth’s\ngetting all gritty...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What, the battle’s over? I was still spitting\nout sand...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Even sandstorms won’t give you any trouble if\nyou’ve got Safety Goggles in hand!\r\nThe sand will still get in your mouth though!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Harsh landscapes\nare the best! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Harsh landscapes like this are the best for\ngood-quality training!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So harsh!!!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: What would happen if I trained on a tropical\nbeach instead? Would it be...not very effective?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Gosh, it was amazing! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Oh my gosh, I saw something amazing! Wanna\nknow what it was?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I saw an amaaazing Pokémon right here!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
A huuuge Pokémon like one of those big towers
in Levincia came right out of the ground!\c
It looked just like the giant Diglett statues they
have in some other region!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Ah, sad songs... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you a fan of sad songs? Or not so much?\nMy personal opinion is...they’re OK, I guess!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It’s a sad, sad loss in a sad, sad world. ♪\nTra la la laaa. ♪

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Just a theory of mine, but I think cheery people\ntend to be more fond of sad songs!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Tick-tock-tick-tock. ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Come on! Let’s have a battle of luck!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Is your luck good? Or is mine just bad?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Metronome is a move that leaves everything to\nluck! So it wasn’t my skill that failed me.

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Let’s talk about me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! Don’t you think I’m awful cute?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I wish you’d show a little more respect for my\ncuteness.

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe I should have spent more time making my\nPokémon really cute?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ll see if you’re worthy. ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you a student, child? Allow me to test your\nabilities!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That was conceited of me...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My apologies. You were the superior Trainer.

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You got moxie, kid? ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I want to battle someone with serious moxie! Are\nyou that someone?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You outmoxied me!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: That was the best battle I’ve had in a while!\nThanks for talking to me, kid!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Everything here’s\nso rugged... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Seems rough and rugged places like this attract\na lot of hardy Pokémon, huh?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wow! The Trainers are hardy, too!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If I want to find soft, fluffy Pokémon, should I\nlook in a flower meadow or something?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hey! Hold up,\nwould you? ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Tagtree Thicket up ahead isn’t safe—you’ll run\ninto a bunch of delinquents.

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wow, you’re strong. I guess you didn’t need\nmy advice!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: They’re from a group called Team Star? People\nsay they’re delinquents, right? Not that they’ve\r\ndone anything to me, mind you, but still...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What Pokémon do\nyou think I’ll use? ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Did you talk to me because you thought I’d use\nDragon-type Pokémon?

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You were right! It’s dragons all the way!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe this outfit isn’t doing me any good.\nEveryone can tell which type I’ll be using...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Any day now! ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My baby is due any day now! I gotta get serious!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I wish I could’ve gotten a bit more serious in\nthat battle!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_WORKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When my kid is old enough, I’ll be sure to send\nthem to the same school you go to!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: According to my\ncalculations... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I calculated it all, and I knew the likelihood you’d\ncome talk to me was 100 percent!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I failed to calculate my chances of winning...

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Do you have lessons with Ms. Tyme?\nThey’re really fun if you love math!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: He loves me...\nHe loves me not... ▶

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If I beat you, I’m gonna tell my crush how I feel!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost! Oh, thank goodness!

label: TRID_AREA14_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: At this rate, I’ll always be holding back on\nmaking any decisive moves...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: In cold places\nlike this... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: In cold places like this, my life gets a bit easier!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Only my deliveries get easier, you know!\nBattling’s as tough as always!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The food I’m delivering doesn’t spoil when it’s\ncold out. For once, I’m not rushed off my feet!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Ah... Aaah! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: ACHOOOOOOOOO!!!\nUm... That was my battle cry!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Choo...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m trying to get to the Glaseado Gym, but boy\nis it cold here!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Here’s the thing\nabout Paldea... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Paldea has all sorts of different climates,\ndepending on where you go!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Brrrrrr!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s so cold in this area! Anyone without warm\nwinter clothes is gonna have a tough time.

text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The snow’s\na-fallin’ down! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey there! Want me ta tell ya the best thing\n’bout the snowy peaks?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Yer strong, that’s fer sure...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s Ice-type Pokémon, o’ course! There’s tons\nof ’em up in the snow!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I gotta get to\nthat concert! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I heard that Ryme, the world-famous rapper, is\nhaving a concert over in Montenevera!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m gonna miss the concert!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Don’t tell me...Montenevera is on the OTHER\nside of the mountain?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You heard of the\nSnow Slope Run? ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I traveled a long way to get here so I could\ntry my hand at the Snow Slope Run.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Battling is also a slippery slope.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: For my Treasure Hunt, I’m gonna get the world\nrecord in the Snow Slope Run! Ehehehe...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh, my dear Grusha... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Grusha used to be a pro snowboarder, you know.\nI came here to meet him, but now I’m lost!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Grushaaa! Where are yooouuu?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I suppose if I head toward the mountain peak, I’ll\neventually spot the Glaseado Gym, where my\r\ndear Grusha awaits me...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I sense a strong aura... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Your Pokémon seem[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0001)]s really strong! I wanna\nbattle [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0402)]itthem!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So I was right!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If you made it all the way out here, you’ve gotta\nbe strong for sure.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Woo-hoo! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I was born up north, so I get excited when I\ncome to cold places like this.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You left me out in the cold!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s amazing what a difference it makes when you\nprotect your head and ears against the cold!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: A little more\nrespect, please? ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey, you! You’re not treatin’ the mountain with\nthe respect it deserves!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Just a little bit is all I’m askin’...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You can never be overprepared for a hike! Bring\nall the items you can carry—and then some!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh! It’s someone\nfrom school... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: It’s kind of embarrassing bumping into your\nschoolmates outside of school, huh?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost... Now I’m even more embarrassed.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I hate running into people I know when I’m out\nand about. It’s weird, I know.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Thick Fat is\nwhere it’s at! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My protective layer of fat keeps me nice and\ntoasty even out in the cold!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Being nice and toasty didn’t help me win...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Pokémon with the Thick Fat Ability receive less\ndamage from Fire- and Ice-type moves!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: This is the perfect\nplace to train! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I come to harsh environments like this to train my\nbody and soul. That’s just my style!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My Pokémon and I were too busy hunkering\ndown against the cold.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
The body temperatures of most Dragon types
vary greatly with their environment.\c
That’s why they don’t handle ice and snow all
that well.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What is art? ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What is art? I...I don’t even know anymore.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That last move of yours was pure art!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I feel motivation welling up inside me! Cheers for\nthe battle!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Careful there,\nyoung one. ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You ought to be careful. There’s no shortage of\nstrong Trainers in these parts.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I suppose none of the other Trainers were as\nstrong as you.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: A weak Trainer could never make it up here.\nI apologize for judging you prematurely.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ll use the snow! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m going to use snow to make art! That’s why I\ncame up here!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh nooo! I just realized something!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_ARTIST_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Any art that I make out of snow is going to melt\nas soon as I take it with me off this mountain!\r\nArgh! Back to square one.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Time to whip out\nmy camera app! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll take an awesome video of this battle with my\ncamera app! It’s gonna blow up everyone’s feeds!

text: My posts never get any likes or comments. Is it\nbecause I don’t have any followers?

text: Clear your mind... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If you clear your mind of all worldly thoughts,\neven fire will feel cool!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Brrrrrr... C-c-clear y-y-your m-m-mind...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Snow still feels cold even if you clear your mind!\nWhat gives?!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: YODEL-AY-HEE-HOOO! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: YODEL-AY-HEE-HOOO!\nWah! Who are you?!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: No, really! Who ARE you?!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I like how you can “yodel-ay-hee-hoo” up here\nand get a “yodel-ay-hee-hoo” right back!\r\nWonder who’s doing the responding.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I wanna be a hiker! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hikers are great! So strong and free and cool!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Being strong and free is tough...

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Mountains are dangerous, huh? Maybe I’ll head\nto the forests instead!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: White snow all around... ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: A bitter defeat... ♪

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I came here to compose haiku, but only wintry\nverses are springing to mind.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: KAPOW! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_KARATE_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Guess it doesn’t matter how much I train my fists\nof fury—they’re no good in Pokémon battles.

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Mi-mi-miiiiii! ♪\nMa-ma-maaa! ♪ ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Glaseado Mountain has such nice, fresh air!\nI can sing so well up here!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That’s all from me-me-me-meeeeee! ♪\n...Oh! I struck that note beautifully!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I might cause an avalanche if I sing too\nloudly, huh?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: ’Sup! ▶

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: ’Sup! Wild Bull Transport, at your service!\nWhat say we have a quick battle?

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Errr! Guess I wasn’t wild enough!

label: TRID_AREA17_TRAINER_DELIVERER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Wild Bull Transport has Tauros as our mascot!\nNeed goods delivered? Our Tauros-strength\r\nmuscles will get it there!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: This new kid’s really shaking things up...

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Aha! My hypothesis was correct! People in this\nregion talk to each other to start battles!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

Even if you fall from high up, your Rotom Phone

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I started out from\nthe west gate! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! I started out from the west gate\nof Mesagoza!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Did you start out from the west gate too?!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Starting from the west side puts you closer to the\nGyms in Cortondo and Cascarrafa!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Is this for you? ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you the one who ordered a pizza to be\ndelivered out here?

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Just a passerby, huh?

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I should’ve listened better when they told me\nwhere to deliver this pizza...

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Just call a\nFlying Taxi! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you a Pokémon Trainer? Flying Taxi fees are\nwaived for Trainers.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re most definitely a Trainer, all right!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Pokémon League pays the Flying Taxi fares\nfor all Trainers, so take all the rides you like.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So THAT’S a desert... ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve always dreamed of seeing a desert with my\nown eyes.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re full of energy, huh? Just like the desert.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m so glad I had the courage to enroll in the\nacademy. It let me have experiences like this one!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re even wilder than the rolling boulders!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I wonder if I could get up to the peak riding on a\nPokémon if I just avoided the boulders?

text: Watch out for Team Star. They have a real unique\nway of battling.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_TANPAN_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

text: Hey! Let’s talk! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Getting to interact with the locals wherever you\ngo is one of the best parts of traveling.

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: W-wow! You’re quite the character!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Kids from Paldea are pretty strong, huh?! I hope\nI brought enough Potions...

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Guess what’s in\nmy backpack? ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Inside my backpack, I have...Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ahhh... I even packed up my best Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I keep all sorts of special stuff in my backpack!\nWhat do you keep in yours?

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Fighting types\nare the best! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Black Belts just HAVE to choose Fighting-type\nPokémon!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now that was a tough fight!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_KARATE_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
We Black Belts love our Fighting-type Pokémon,
you know!\c
So don’t come at us with Psychic- or Flying-types
or anything like that!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It was carryin’ a coin! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m tryin’a find a widdle Pokémon carryin’ a coin!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m tryin’ so hard! But I can’t find it! I just stare\ninto the tall grass...

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: That widdle coin Pokémon runs away fast! You\ncan’t catch it, but it drops a coin if you find it!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

text: Ahhh! I’m just no good! No good at all!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: See? I told you!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DELIVERER_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m no good as a courier. I always skip out on\nwork to battle. That’s bad, isn’t it?

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Brand-spankin’ new! ▶

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m a brand-spankin’ new Dragon Tamer! I’ll rawr\nat ya with my dragon power!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Aren’t Dragon-types supposed to be strong?!

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA09_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
