text: Casseroya! Casseroya! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! What does Casseroya mean? That’s all I can\nthink about recently!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait! I know! Maybe it’s a royal casserole?!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: By the way, Casseroya Lake is to the north—but\nyou won’t get very far if you can’t swim!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: To the west... ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: There’s a town to the west! But there’s an\nopponent right in front of you!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re strong regardless of what direction you’re\nheaded, huh?!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The market town of Porto Marinada lies to the\nwest! By the way, west is the direction marked in\r\nyellow on the map app.

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So strong! So rare! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You want to see my strong and rare Pokémon,\ndon’t you? DON’T YOU?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So strong! So wonderful!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I hear there are Pokémon out there with different\ncoloration than other members of their species.\r\nI sure would like to see one of those someday!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Natuuure! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Let’s have a battle out here surrounded by all this\nsoothing nature!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, that wasn’t very soothing...

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m gonna have a picnic at all the spots in Paldea\nwith good views.

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Can you help me? ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If I win, can you help me by making my deliveries\nin my stead?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I knew that wouldn’t work!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess this loss was the motivation I needed!\nTime to get back to work!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I want... ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I want power!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Your power! It’s overwhelming!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: How did you get so powerful?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Heeelp! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Heeelp! My hand throws Poké Balls all on its own!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Guess I picked the wrong opponent. Hmph!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I gotta get ready for the next person, so you go\naway, OK? Go!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Top spot! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Mountains are a top spot in my book...because\nthey’re so high up! Get it?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I lost! I did, did I?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Phrases like “top spot” are called palindromes!\nThey read the same forwards and backwards!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I prefer the indoors! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I prefer the indoors, but I came here to see this\namazing sight.

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What an amazing sight!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
This place is called Colonnade Hollow. It’s one of
the Ten Sights of Paldea.\c
I’m going to research how the area came to be
shaped this way!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hey! Do you know... ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! Do you know... Do you know how strong\nI am?!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I was just a big fish in a small pond...but you\nshowed me what the ocean is like!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: There are people more talented than me all over\nthis great big world of ours, huh?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The ocean is so vast... ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Let’s have a battle here with a refreshing\nocean view!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What? This isn’t the ocean? It’s a lake?!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My map app says this body of water is a lake...\nAren’t lakes basically just tiny oceans?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: She’s so popular! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Have you heard of the superpopular streamer\nnamed Iono?

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ah! I was going to buy merch with that money!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Iono’s a streamer and a Gym Leader, too! She’s\nalso super cute! You should watch her stuff.

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Welcome! ▶

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Welcome to the outdoor café! Our special today\nis the taste of defeat—coming right up!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ah... so THIS is what defeat tastes like!

label: TRID_AREA11_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Defeat doesn’t taste so bad once you get used\nto it. An acquired taste, I suppose?

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My Pokémon\nis the cutest! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My Pokémon is obviously the cutest, but my\nfriends just don’t get it!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I don’t mind losing, as long as I got to convey to\nyou how cute Dedenne is!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Some people don’t like Dedenne because it\nsteals electricity. But honestly, being a li’l thief\r\njust makes it even cuter...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You been to Medali? ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Medali’s famous Treasure Eatery gets a one-star\nreview from me!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Your battle skill is five stars!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I heard you can change your Pokémon’s Tera\nType at the Treasure Eatery, but that stubborn\r\nchef wouldn’t even give me the time of day!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Behold my illusions! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I will show you the illusion of the century!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You saw right through my illusions!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Zorua’s always disguised as some other Pokémon.\nIt’s really hard to find!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Where’s the\nbattle court...? ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I need to make a delivery to Medali’s\nbattle court!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I can’t find my destination OR my way to victory...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_DELIVERER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Medali has a Gym, but I don’t see a battle\ncourt anywhere!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Work, work, work... ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Right! I’ve made up my mind!\nI’ll go to work if I win this battle!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Woooooo! I lost, so I guess I’m taking today off!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Just to be clear, I didn’t lose just so I could take\nthe day off, OK? I would never do that.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: When two\nTrainers meet... ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: A battle is unavoidable when two Trainers meet!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Where there’s a victor, there’s also a loser.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Battling you reminded me of how I used to be—\npicking fights with everyone I came across.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The ice cream vendor... ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: The ice cream vendor at Medali was selling\nsomething mighty strange.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That wasn’t very sweet of you!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I didn’t know modern ice cream vendors had such\nsalty-sweet ice cream!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hee hee hee! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hee hee hee! I’m kinda the main attraction at\nmy café!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Hey! Don’t steal my appeal!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m the adorable battling barista! Hope to see\nyou at the café sometime!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My Pokémon is\nobviously the cutest! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Wanna know the cutest Pokémon of them all?\n’Cause I’m gonna tell you!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Allow me to illustrate for you the many qualities\nthat make Pawmo such a cute— Wait, I lost?

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MUSICIAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
OK, so, what makes Pawmo so cute is how it
hustles its little heart to keep up when you’ve got
it walking around with you—and ohmygosh,
I even heard that if you walk with it enough,
it might even evolve, and I just absolutely
CANNOT EVEN with how cute it is! Hee hee!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Could you be...? ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Could you be...what I’m here to clean up?

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You wiped the floor with me...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My mistake—I took you for someone else.\nNow go away and don’t talk to me.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: If I had to pick... ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If I had to pick between the hike up a mountain\nand the hike down...the hike down’s more fun!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I took a steep fall!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When two people on a mountain trail pass each\nother, the one going up has the right of way!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: We’ve got to\nsynergize! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: We’ve got to synergize across all metrics! Let’s\npivot and take this offline.

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: We need to circle back on this...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You really leveraged your core competencies.\nI need to drill down on improving...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Talk to me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey, you talked to me! Thanks. Now let’s battle!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wow, you’re bold!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess you wouldn’t have come talk to me if you\nweren’t confident in your battle skills...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I think my Pokémon\nis the cutest. ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You seem to have a discerning eye. Have a look\nat the cutest Pokémon there is!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ah, how utterly adorable Bergmite looks when\nit’s defeated...

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
It’s plain as day that Bergmite’s the cutest of all,
but my friends just don’t see it.\c
Anyway, you can find Bergmite on Glaseado
Mountain. You ought to catch one for yourself!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s gotta be nearby... ▶

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: They say there’s a tunnel around here that leads\ninto the Great Crater of Paldea!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Looks like my search is getting cut short!

label: TRID_AREA12_TRAINER_RESEARCHER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I’ve also heard there’s some research facility near
the entrance of the Great Crater of Paldea...\c
They say it’s fallen into disuse, but...ooh, I want
to find it so bad! I just want to see what’s there!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I am a Dragon Tamer... ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: We Dragon Tamers are wielders of dragon\nPokémon!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It seems you are even better at wielding your\npreferred Pokémon than I am.

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Dragons are a challenge to raise, but they have\nfew weaknesses. If you can raise them to be\r\nstrong enough, victory will be yours.

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I don’t wanna... ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I don’t wanna do my job! No!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Waaaaaahhh! You meaniehead!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I’ve actually been having a really tough time at
work lately, but that sure helped!\c
There’s nothing like letting yourself act childish
when you’re feeling overwhelmed!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Astounding! ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Astounding! You have a Tera Orb, do you?

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: How dazzling!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Tera Orbs are quite precious, so only the best\nstudents and teachers are allowed to have them.

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Wahaha! ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Wahaha! I’m out here enjoying my youth on my\nTreasure Hunt!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wahaha! Nothing will stop my enjoyment!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The only way to win in life is to enjoy it!\nIt’s a waste to think you should or shouldn’t\r\ndo something simply because of your age!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I want to be\nlike the wind... ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I want to be like the wind and travel across the\nwhole wide world!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Why are the winds of fate always blowing\nagainst me?!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I saw this floaty Pokémon wafting along on the\nbreeze nearby!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: “Beep-beep-beep” goes the\ncabbie, all through the sky ♪ ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Gah! Where’d you come from?! I was singing to\nmyself thinking there was no one around!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I couldn’t even win, I was so embarrassed...

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I was trying to think up a jingle to use on our\ncommercials for the Flying Taxi...\r\n“All through the sky...” ♪

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I just can’t decide! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I just can’t decide! What do you think?\c\nShould I go to Artazon to experience real art?\nOr Levincia for big-city thrills?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess I should have been worrying more about\nwhich move to use in battle...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Maybe I’ll go experience the art in Artazon...\nThere are a bunch of different art installations\r\non display all over the town.

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s just no good... ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: It’s just no good! I...I can’t control my power!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Phew! Thanks for helping me tamp down my\npower like that! It can be pretty overwhelming!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My power is too great for my own good.\nSometimes it runs amok, and I just defeat every\r\nTrainer I meet. Glad that didn’t happen to you!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What should I throw...? ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Pop quiz! What should I throw if I want to start\na battle?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, that result sure threw me!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s so nice how you can just throw a Poké Ball\ncontaining one of your Pokémon at a wild\r\nPokémon to dive right into a battle!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ll stick with it! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll show you! I’m tenacious, and I’ll stick it out\nno matter how hard the battle gets!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Even though you’ve beat me, I still won’t give up!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Attacking isn’t the only way to be strong! There\nare all kinds of moves that help you stick it out!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My Pokémon! ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My Pokémon! And your Pokémon! What’s so\ndifferent about them?!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: E-everything’s different!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Individual Pokémon have different individual\nstrengths, even if they’re the same species.

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: All right! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: All right! Just one bout! This’ll be a good\nwarm-up before I head to the work site!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That didn’t warm me up at all...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You’re real strong, kid! What do you do to\nwarm up?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Enjoying your day off? ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Enjoying your day off? ’Cause I am!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Goodness, you’re strong!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CLEANING_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I finally took some time off work, but I just\ncouldn’t leave my cleaning supplies behind...\r\nMaybe I work too much...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-hooo! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-hooo! Get ready to see a real\nchef at work!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Now why’d you go and do that?! I just wanted to\nmake some sandwiches for a picnic!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When your Pokémon are feeling rough after\nbattling, feed them sandwiches to perk them up.

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Your bill... ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If you lose to me, your bill will be 1,000,000!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait, I got the math wrong!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITRESS_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I-I was only kidding before! You didn’t really\nexpect me to pay you THAT much, did you?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Squawkabilly! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What powers our Flying Taxis? Squawkabilly’s\nplucky spirit!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What spirit! I love it!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Did you know that wild Squawkabilly of the same\ncolor tend to flock together?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My map keeps spinning! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: The map app in my phone keeps spinning!\nMake it stop!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m in a real downward spiral now!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
So you can set your map so that north is always
at the top, can you?\c
As you get up in years like me, figuring out these
smartphones can make you feel awful dumb!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I saw you at the school, talking so familiarly with\nDirector Clavell!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, sweet Clavell, what do you see in this\nne’er-do-well...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Director Clavell has such a gentle and refined\ndemeanor. He’s simply lovely...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: To be a waiter... ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: To be a waiter is to wait. I’ll wait for the perfect\nmoment to take care of you!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: N-now wait just a moment!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WAITER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My battle strategy hinges on sometimes waiting\nfor my opponent to land a blow before I do.\r\nBut sometimes I lose if I wait too long...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Sunflora! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Sunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation!\nSunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation!\r\nI made up my own tongue twister!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Sunflora flood the flooof—\nDah! No! I messed up!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Sunflora flood the floral fiefdom in formation! I\nmade my tongue twister ’cause I love Sunflora.\c\nThe Gym Test in Artazon was right up my alley!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My reason for living! ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My work is my reason for living! It’s something\nthat’s worth doing, and it gives me purpose!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, since I lost, I guess I’ll be getting back to\nwork now!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_WORKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
If you do what you love for work, then at least
you know you’ll enjoy that part of your life!\c
It won’t be all fun and games, but it’s still better
than a kick in the teeth!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Fire crew... ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Did you know Team Star’s Fire crew has a base\nnear here?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You’re on fire!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The boss of the Fire crew is this girl named Mela.\nShe talks real tough and scares me silly!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Great Crater\nof Paldea... ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Have you been to the Great Crater of Paldea?

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What! You beat me?! My confidence is cratering!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: They say that there’s this mysterious place called\nArea Zero inside the Great Crater of Paldea—\r\nand that great treasures sleep within it!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I wanna be\nnumber one! ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I wanna be number one! I’m gonna be\nthe strongest!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess maybe we can share being number one!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Outta all the Champions, there’s a number-one\nstrongest one called the Top Champion!\r\nBoy, that’s what I wanna be someday!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Y’know what? ▶

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Y’know what? I wanna become real strong.\nJus’ like Missy Nemona is!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: G-gotta be like Missy Nemona!

label: TRID_AREA16_TRAINER_SCH_INFANT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: *sniffle* O-oh... *sniffle* Thanks for the battle...\c\nDoes Missy Nemona cry when she loses?\nI...I guess I’ve gotta be...t-tough...

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Are you the client...? ▶

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Are you the client? Did you manage to bring the,\nah, sample that I contacted you about?

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I-I’m pretty sure you aren’t my client! Please!\nDon’t make me battle any more!

label: TRID_AREA15_TRAINER_BUSINESSMAN_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Sh-shove off, won’t you! Before anyone sees!\nI’m supposed to meet someone here who said\r\nthey’d show me some super cute Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: That was one\ntasty-looking Pokémon. ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I don’t know how to describe it, but it’s...like...\nman, that Pokémon I saw! It looked delicious!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I don’t know how to put this, but...like...thanks\nfor the battle!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
So this really tasty-looking Pokémon, right? It was
just going along, then this other huge Pokémon
went and, like, gulped it right down!\c
I guess that’s what happens when you look so
darn tasty. You get eaten, that’s what.

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ve heard the rumors... ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve heard the rumors of a Pokémon in these\nlands—one known as the False Dragon Titan!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: But what is this False Dragon?! What is real?!\nWhat is false?!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Could it be that the False Dragon Titan isn’t a\nreal dragon at all? But...but...\c\nWhat’s even the point if it’s not a real dragon?

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Take a picture for\nme, would you? ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m about to beat you. It’d be great if you could\ntake a commemorative photo for me when I do!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I don’t need a photo to commemorate losing!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Um, sorry if I was a bit over the top just then...\c\nAll this wide-open space really gives the ol’\nemotions room to run wild!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hoooh! Haaah! ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hoooh! Haaah!\nHoooh! Haaah!\r\nYes, the air out here truly is fine! Breathe deep!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Why, I detect a hint of a salt on the breeze!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The air out here is the best of any I’ve had. I’d\nhappily live on it all my remaining days!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oooh! Ow-ow-ow! ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I spent too long crouched down sneaking through\nthe tall grass—now my back is killing me!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I wonder if I could’ve won if my back wasn’t\nacting up like this...

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_MIDDLE_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You can get close to wild Pokémon without them\nnoticing you if you crouch down nice and low.\r\nBut your back might regret it...

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Wow, all the\nway out here? ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You’ve sure put in some effort, coming all the\nway out here on your own little legs.

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Those little legs hold up some real great skills!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_TAXIDRIVER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
There aren’t any towns or Pokémon Centers or
anything around these parts.\c
If you get tired, don’t try to tough it out! Give a
Flying Taxi a call!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: What if I put\nthe camera here? ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m actually a singer, see. I came out here to\nscout a location for my next music video.

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I got beat by some...some NOBODY?!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: That’s it! We’re definitely not filming here!\c\nI can’t even stand here without remembering that\nI lost a battle to someone like you!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The greatest view of all... ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m traveling the expanse of Paldea in search of\nthe greatest view of all.

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I wonder how the world looks in your eyes?

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I thought I might have finally found the greatest\nview of all here, but it seems I was wrong...\r\nI think there are still greater sights to aspire to!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Mushroom! Mushroom! ▶

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Mushroom! Mushroom? MushROOOOOOM!

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh! My word! Please forgive me! I was quite\ncaught up in my own world there for a moment...

label: TRID_AREA18_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I was playing with the adorable little mushroom\nPokémon and lost all track of where I was!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: *pant pant* ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I was...climbing this rock face...so I’m...outta\nbreath...but my team’s...fine!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Phew... Hah!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MOUNTAIN_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If only I could...ride a Pokémon and let it do the\nclimbing...

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: If I could only\ncross the sea... ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Lend me a Pokémon that can take me across\nthe sea!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Looks like I’m sunk!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_BACKPACKER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If only there was some Pokémon I could ride over\nthe sea, I could be sitting and sipping something\r\non a sandy beach right now!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Been out east? ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: One of Team Star’s bases is off to the east of\nhere. So scary!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess if I was as strong as you, I wouldn’t need\nto be scared, even of Team Star!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_BOY_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Team Star’s Fighting crew has a base off to the\neast of here, and their boss is super scary...\r\nTh-that grim look she’s always got—brrr!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Quite the traveler,\naren’t you? ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You’ve come a good long way since setting out\nfrom the academy, haven’t you?

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Yes, I could feel precisely how much experience\nyou’ve gained on your travels.

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
You and I have both walked the same distance,
and yet I still lost to you.\c
I suppose that the paths you’ve chosen must have
been richer in what they offered.

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: This...is...ridiculous! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: So ridiculous! I was doing the Snow Slope Run on\nGlaseado Mountain and ended up...here!\r\nWhere the heck is “here” anyway?!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Whoa! Your Pokémon are ridiculously strong!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_GIRL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I wasn’t actually planning to come here, but this\nended up pretty fun, too! Huh!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Yes! At last! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hey! Hey, you there! You’re mine! Once I defeat\nyou, you’ll be another “feather in my cap”!\r\nBut what does that even mean?!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Looks like we may never know!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_MANIA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Sure, if you just looked up the phrase, you could\nfind out in a sec what it means...but it’s fun\r\nmaking people stop and wonder!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Sandwiches... Yes... ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Apparently this one earl thought up sandwiches\nbecause he wanted to be able to eat while\r\nkeeping a hand free to play games!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess Pokémon battling isn’t really a game...\nSeems I can’t pull it off one-handed!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_SCH_YOUNG_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I love learning the history of things. I always ace\nall my history tests, too.

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I am the\ndragon’s wings! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I am the eldest of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s wings! I’ll blast you away!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It seems I failed to take flight...

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Dragons may be slow to grow, but if you put the\ntime into raising one, they’re fearsomely strong!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I am the\ndragon’s breath! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I am the second of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s breath! I’ll blow you away!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You left me no time to catch my breath...

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Dragons are weak to Ice-type moves, and they\nhave a hard time taking on cute little fairies, too.

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I am the\ndragon’s tail! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I am the youngest of three sisters, the one who’s\nclaimed the dragon’s tail! And I’ll send you flying!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I might have to turn tail and run!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_DRAGONTAMER_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It was my big sister who thought up this whole\nthing about us being different parts of a dragon...\r\nHonestly, I find it all a bit embarrassing.

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So free! ▶

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m no longer bound by the office! The whole\nwide world is my office now!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I think it’s time I clock out for the day!

label: TRID_AREA21_TRAINER_OL_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Hmmm. If the whole world is my office...does that\nmean I never actually leave work?

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Bamboo shoots pop-\npop-popping up! ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I came out hunting for bamboo shoots, but I\nguess I could forage for battles while I’m at it!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Shoot, I was so busy thinking about bamboo\nthat I didn’t focus on the battle...

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_CHEF_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Big Bamboo Shoots are quite valuable, so you\ncan sell them at shops for a tidy profit!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Unbelievable! ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Gosh, I feel like a buffoon! I thought the thing\nI saw was just a mushroom, but it was ALIVE!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess there really are fungus among us!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Mushroom Pokémon Foongus is poisonous\ntoo, so be careful around it!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: These falls... ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: These falls are said to be quite famous. I’ll help\ncommemorate your visit with a fine battle!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I got so worked up the sweat was pouring down\nmy back like a cascade!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_ARTIST_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: They’re called the Fury Falls...but I wonder what’s\ngot them so angry?

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Pro...wrestling? ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You young’uns call that flashy sport pro wrestling,\nright? Is it popular among your set these days?

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It seems you are a pro at Pokémon battles.

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_SCH_SENIOR_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I saw a student up ahead who was all done up in
the most outrageous pro wrestling outfit.\c
It was absolutely splendid! I wonder if she would
let me join her in her shenanigans?

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hyah! Rah! ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I got my black belt through an online course!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait, this stuff is way harder in real life?!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_KARATE_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Nowadays you can do everything online! It’s a\nnew age of remote learning!

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’ll. Show. YOU! ♥  ▶

label: TRID_AREA22_TRAINER_MODEL_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: There’s nothing like the warm glow of good\nsportsmanship!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_CHILD_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Here in Kitakami, we expect Trainers to call out\nto one another before getting into a battle.\r\nIt’s probably the same where you’re from, right?

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_INFANT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’ve gotta tell you, though... Loyalty Plaza’s not\nall it’s cracked up to be. It’s just a big empty lot\r\nthat happens to have the Loyal Three Monument.

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC1_TRAINER_J_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA07_DLC1_TRAINER_SCARY_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Savanna Biome! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Welcome to the Savanna Biome! The plains here\nstretch as far as the eye can see!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Whoa, you’re a wild one!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s really hard to keep your hair looking good\nhere. The heat and humidity cause so much frizz!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: How about a\nDouble Battle? ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Think you’re good at Double Battles? Why don’t\nyou test that theory by battling me?

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You don’t have to tell me twice—you’re an ace at\nDouble Battles!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Double Battles are the norm here at Blueberry\nAcademy. You can pull out some tricky strategies\r\nwith ’em, which is what makes them so fun.

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Elite Four of\nthe BB League! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My goal is to defeat the BB League Elite Four!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: No way—are you in the upper ranks yourself?!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Savanna Biome’s Elite Four member is called\nCrispin. He’s only a first-year student here, but\r\nhis Pokémon are super strong!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I don’t feel like doing\nmy homework... ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I really don’t want to do my homework, so I\nended up coming here to the Terarium.

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Even getting beat by you doesn’t make me want\nto go deal with my homework!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: “Write 800 words summarizing Pokémon Abilities\nand the advantages they can offer in battle”...?\r\nWho wants to do a thing like that?!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Crispin of the\nElite Four... ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you want to know why Crispin is strong\nenough to be a member of the Elite Four?

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Yeowch! You’re tough enough to take the heat\nof battling Crispin!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Crispin uses Fire-type Pokémon, see, but he
manages to cover their weaknesses well, which
is why he’s so strong in battle.\c
If you’re not careful, he’ll turn the tables on you
with a fierce Solar Beam to the face!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So much mud! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Playing in the mud is the best, right? I hope\nyou’re ready to have your face right in it!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, I ended up with mud on my face...

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Mud-Slap is a great move for dealing damage\nwhile also lowering your opponent’s accuracy!\r\nIt’s strong and smart! Mud really is the best!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m knocking out\nsome BBQs! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m doing some BBQs with my pals during our\nbreak between classes!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Beating you is a quest I’ll never be able to\ncomplete!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You can get even more BP when do you quests\nwith your friends than when you do them solo.\r\nYou did know that, right?

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Right in the middle\nof the Terarium! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Do you know what you’ll find right in the middle\nof the Terarium?!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, I’m certainly not finding any victory here,\nthat’s for sure...

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: In the very middle of the Terarium is the Central\nPlaza—it’s a great meet-up spot!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Have a look at that\nTerarium Core! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Staring up at the Terarium Core on the ceiling\ngave me a real crick in my neck!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: At least the shock of losing is a great distraction\nfrom my neck pain!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Ms. Briar handles all the maintenance work on the\nTerarium Core, you know.

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Healing\nmachines! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m the best in my whole class at using the self-\nserve healing machines to heal up my team!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, I lost! Time to go use that healing machine!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My dream is to work in a Pokémon Center one\nday—then I’ll use healing machines all the time!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Excuse me! ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: So sorry to bother you, but do you know where\nwe are? I’m completely lost!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: So sorry for the poor show in battle, too!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m trying to reach the Central Plaza. Was it not\nthis way...?

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Are you lost? ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Did you get lost and wander up here? Don’t\nworry, Sophie’s here to show you the way.

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess you had a thing or two to show me...

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: If you just follow the block walls, you’ll end up in\nthe Central Plaza every time. Easy!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Know what’s\nup ahead? ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: The Coastal Biome lies on the other side of this\nwall here! You ready for a nice beach vacay?!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oof, I think I could use a cool dip after that burn\nyou just gave me!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Coastal Biome is so sunny and relaxing—and\nthe scenery! Boy, do I ever love the scenery!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Aren’t you...? ▶

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Aren’t you that exchange student everyone’s\ntalking about? Could I trouble you for a battle?

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Ah! I feel that Paldean spirit washing over me!

label: TRID_AREA01_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You came from Paldea, right? I really hope to\ngo there myself someday!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: An indoor sea... ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: There’s a sea here, inside the Terarium’s dome...\nIs it the same as the sea outside, though?!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Your strength is as vast and immeasurable as the\nsea itself!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: This school floats in the sea, but within the\nschool...is another sea...\c\nI feel out to sea tryin’ to wrap my head around it!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Maybe with Dig... ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You know the Pokémon move Dig? I wonder if I\ncould tunnel right through this mountain with it...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Looks like I dug myself into a hole there...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Pokémon can’t be hit by moves when they’re
underground using Dig!\c
EXCEPT! You’ve gotta watch out for Earthquake.
It not only hits—it does more damage than usual!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Alolan forms! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m raising Alolan Form Pokémon! Look!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Did you get a good look?! Those’re Alolan\nforms all right!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Even if you haven’t caught a Pokémon yourself,\nyou can check out some of their details in your\r\nPokédex if you’ve battled ’em at least once.

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s all mine... ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: This is my own private beach, that no one else\nknows about! What do you want?!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess it’s a bit too private—I’m clearly out of\npractice for battle!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: This is basically a dead end, so I’m usually the\nonly one who bothers to come here.

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: No thoughts,\njust vibes... ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m just vibing... You?

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Huh... Guess you managed to keep your focus.

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When you’re all worn out, vibing is where it’s at.\nEverybody’s gotta empty their head sometimes.

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Double Battles! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If you’re gonna have a Double Battle, then\nyou’ve gotta have strategy! Watch and learn!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It hurts twice as much to lose a Double Battle!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s important to consider how you can attack all\nopponents or protect yourself in a Double Battle!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: *sigh* ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: *sigh*\nHe just radiates coolness...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oooh, he really is just the coolest!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I’d like to talk to him before I graduate, but he’s
always on the move...\c
*sigh*
You’re so cool, Director Cyrano!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Into the Polar Biome! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I can do it! I’m all pumped up! I’m definitely\nready to venture into the Polar Biome!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: D’ahhh, I think I’ve got cold feet...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s SUPER cold in the Polar Biome, you know?!\c\nThey totally managed to give it an arctic feel.\nThe power of science—it’s sure something!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m part of the Elite Four! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’m part of the Elite Four—the part that shows up\nto challenge them, that is!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: My cool self-intro was all for nothing...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I was practicing my self-intro for when I become\na full-fledged member of the Elite Four, see.\r\nThen you showed up...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Slowpoke! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I just LOVE Slowpoke! How about you?

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Slow-noooooo!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
The Slowpoke you find here in the Coastal
Biome are Galarian Slowpoke.\c
Apparently there are some fairly tropical areas
in Galar where Slowpoke are found!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I know Lacey’s secret! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I know Lacey’s secret! Shall I share it with you?

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Geez, cool your jets! I’ll tell you, all right?!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
OK, you’ve earned it—I’ll tell you Lacey’s secret!\c
Apparently...Lacey sometimes takes naps using
one of her Pokémon’s soft tummy as a pillow!
Did you know that?

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I just love Alola! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve become absolutely obsessed with the Alola\nregion since I came to this school!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: You may have beaten me in battle, but you can’t\nbeat me when it comes to my love of Alola!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m gonna take a trip to Alola soon! And I’ll\nfinally get to try those malasadas myself!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I simply adore\nbird Pokémon! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Ever since I entered this school, I’ve dedicated\nmyself wholeheartedly to training bird Pokémon!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Noooooo! Chirpy! Peeper!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: As long as bird Pokémon stay safely aloft,\nGround-type moves don’t hit them!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s all about spirit! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If you just put enough spirit in, there’s no way\nyou’ll lose! Here I go!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Th-that was a whole week’s worth of spirit\nfor me—!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m in real low spirits now, ’cause of you...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Where am I?! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Where am I?! And who are you?! Wait, are you\nan opponent?!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wha-?! I’m losing it in here!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: This cave system is like a maze! Gets you lost and\nbewildered enough to battle everyone on sight...

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m in the League Club! ▶

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Watch out—I’m a strong one! Why, you ask?\nBecause I’m in the League Club, that’s why!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait, but...I’m part of the League Club! How\ncould I have lost?!

label: TRID_AREA02_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I guess just being a part of a club isn’t enough
to guarantee anything.\c
You’ve still gotta work hard to be a worthy
member of it, huh!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: The Canyon Biome... ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You new to the Canyon Biome? Don’t worry—\nI’ll show you the ropes.

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: W-wait! Aren’t you supposed to be new to this?!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: There’re tons of cliffs to watch out for here. If\nyou run around willy-nilly, you’re bound to fall!\r\nBe careful, OK?

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Oh, Amarys! Most\nworthy Amarys! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Most worthy Amarys of the Elite Four! How I wish\nI might become strong enough to approach you!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, Amarys... Am I any closer now to the heights\nwhere you dwell?

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Our most worthy Amarys maintains a composed\nexterior, but she’s really very kind underneath!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: ... ... ...\nYou wanna battle?

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: ... ... ...\nGuess I lost, huh.

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I read an article that said the cool, silent type is\nalways popular with the ladies, but...is it really?

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Let’s do some\naddition! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Plusle! Minun! We’re going to add our power\ntogether to go all out!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess my contribution was the real minus here...

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Some Pokémon can power each other up when\nyou put them in a team together!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: All kinds of\nPokémon! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll show you all kinds of Pokémon that I’ve found\nand caught here in the Terarium!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Thanks for showing me your Pokémon too!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: The Terarium was carefully set up to provide a\ngreat habitat for all kinds of different Pokémon.

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: And one, and two,\nand three, and... ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Fou—oh! Look who’s here: a challenger to\ninterrupt our diligent training!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: For shame...

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It would appear that our training still isn’t up to\nsnuff! Thanks for helping me see that!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: *sniffle* ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: *sniffle* I-I had the biggest blowup with my\nbest friend, and now I don’t know what to do!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m so sorry!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess a good apology is what you need after\nany fight, isn’t it? I’ve just got to say it!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Today’s the day! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Today’s the day that I finally defeat Amarys!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: D-defeated in the warm-up round?!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I think I’d better practice a bit more before I try\nto challenge Amarys herself!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Gah?! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: What’re you—?! Why’s there—?! In a place like\nthis—?!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wait—I’m still reeling from the shock! What\nhappened? Did I just lose?!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I’m not kidding—you’re probably the first person\nwho’s ever come here aside from me!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Behold! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll take you on with my team, inspired by the\namazing Amarys herself!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Amazingly shocking, how badly that worked...

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It was amazingly naive of me to think copying\na strong Trainer’s team would make me strong.

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: How romantic! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Don’t you think there’s something incredibly\nromantic about the giant rocks floating in here?

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What a romantic defeat!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Did you know that the rocks in here float thanks\nto electromagnetic fields? Isn’t that amazing?\r\nThose fields are why Magnet Rise works, too!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Higher! And higher! ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ll keep moving higher up the ranks of the BB\nLeague! I’m going to be one of the Elite Four!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wh-what rank are you, kid?!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: When you win, you move up the ranks. When\nyou lose, you move down ’em. If you’re not a\r\nconsistent winner, you’ll never reach the top.

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I just want... ▶

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I just want to enjoy school! I want to have fun in\nmy classes! And in my club after classes, too!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, that sure was fun!

label: TRID_AREA03_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My friends are always hung up on improving their\nrank in the League Club and that kind of stuff.\r\nThey don’t seem to be enjoying school at all.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Team Terribull! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: We call ourselves Team Terribull! Be prepared\nto tremble in fright before our might!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, this is just Terribull...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I still want to win using the Pokémon I love best!\nSo I’ll just keep working harder until I manage it!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Coming and going! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I just keep coming and going, back and forth\nbetween the Coastal Biome and the Polar one!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What a sudden shock to the system!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Moving back and forth between the Coastal\nBiome and the Polar Biome is a shock, all right.\r\nIt really helps you toughen up!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Is this polar?! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I know this is called the Polar Biome, but what\ndoes “polar” mean anyway?!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: P-p-po...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Wait, “polar” is, like, the North or South Pole?\nWell, no wonder it’s so cold here!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Hehehehe... ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Hehehehe... Tell me...\c\nDo you like...occult mysteries?

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I guess you just like...Pokémon...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I want to start...an occult club here at school.\nBut I can’t seem...to attract any members...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Can’t stop it! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: No one can stop me! I’m on a total roll!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Whoa, you rolled right over me...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I thought I’d be able to keep rolling up and up\nthrough the ranks of the BB League... Darn.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Looking for the\nPolar Plaza? ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You looking for the Polar Plaza? Want me to\nshow you the way there?

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, now my Pokémon are too exhausted to\nshow anyone anywhere!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: You can’t actually see it from here, but the Polar\nPlaza is just on the other side of that icy ridge.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Ready for a\nchallenge? ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Thinking of challenging Drayton, are you? You’d\nonly be wasting his time—don’t even dream of it!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Er, never mind! Go right ahead!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_1_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I know Drayton acts like the whole world’s a joke,\nbut he doesn’t mess around in battles.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I’m stuffed! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Urk... I ate enough to burst! I guess a Pokémon\nbattle after eating is a good way to aid digestion!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Urp!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
Everyone’s favorite meal at the cafeteria has got
to be the Academy Special!\c
You can only order it using BP, but the Meal
Powers it gives are amazing!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Because it’s there! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I climb the peak before me because it’s there!\nI beat the Trainer before me because [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s there!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: A truly formidable summit!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I love the mountains! My dream is to graduate\nfrom being a student to being a hiker someday!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: So cooold! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: My Pokémon are all so cooold!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Wow. That’s cold.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Having a whole party of Ice types is like hanging\nout in the freezer section of the supermarket!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Please work out! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve been snoozing through my Pokémon battle\nclasses, but please, please, please let this work!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: That didn’t even come close to working!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_2_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: I guess you can’t just slack off and expect things\nto work out—not with studies or with Pokémon...

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: It’s all to WIN! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve been training the perfect party, all to WIN\nagainst the Polar Biome’s Elite Four member!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: It’s...super effective?!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Drayton—the Elite Four member here in the Polar\nBiome—is the grandson of a famous Gym Leader.\r\nIt’s no wonder his team’s so strong.

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: My dream! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I’ve got to become one of the Elite Four of the\nBB League so my dream can come true at last!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Noooooo! This is going to make my rank go\nDOWN, not up!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: My dream is to become a member of the Elite\nFour...and make a castle out of the plaza blocks!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: You there! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: You there! What year are you in, huh?!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I’m in my second year!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_YOUTH_M_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: It’s hard to know who’s above or below you in\nthis weird school because the kids’ ages have\r\nnothing to do with their school year!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: Wait, aren’t you... ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: Aren’t you that kid who was on the Iono Zone?!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Whosawhatsit?! Iunno!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_M_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text:
I swear, there was a kid who looked just like you
on the Iono Zone.\c
The viewer count for that stream was totally
insane!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: I believe! ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: I believe in my Pokémon! Do you?!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: I can’t believe how strong you are!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_3_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: Pokémon are mysterious as anything, aren’t they?\c\nEven though they don’t speak our language, they\nalways seem to know what we’re thinking!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_POPUP
text: If I only... ▶

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: If I only could’ve beat Crispin...then I’d be the\none in the Elite Four now!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Lost again!

label: TRID_AREA04_DLC2_TRAINER_B_ADULT_F_4_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: OK! I’m ready to move on now!\c\nYou’ve gotta recognize your failures, but that\ndoesn’t mean you’ve gotta have regrets!

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Oh, my! Beautiful job!

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MUSHI_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Avant-GARDE!

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_KUSA_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Y-you...smashed...that subscribe button.

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_DENKI_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: What a great catch!

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_MIZU_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_HIKOU_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_HIKOU_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
text: Well, I’ve had my fill...

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_HIKOU_TRMSG_FIGHT_AFTER
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_GHOST_TRMSG_FIGHT_START
text: [EMPTY 2144]

label: TRID_SU2_BUKATU_GHOST_TRMSG_FIGHT_LOSE
